subject: Procurement MAP & sequencing for BlueBridge pilot
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@bluebridgehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement MAP & contract sequencing for BlueBridge pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the demo last week — BlueBridge is excited to move into a timeboxed pilot for the clinical triage assistant. Procurement/legal asked me to pull together the evaluation plan and a mutual action plan so we can map dependencies to signing. High level asks from our side:

- We need a MAP that lays out evaluation milestones, evidence for security/compliance, and the contract sequencing (MSA/DPA/order form).
- Procurement would like clear handoffs and a target signature window; our internal target is pilot start week of Aug 30 but we can be flexible if legal needs more time.
- Please include acceptance criteria for the pilot and what artifacts will constitute signoff.

I attached the RFP their team shared (BlueBridge_RFP.pdf) — it has some specific data residency/retention questions that legal will flag. Can you send a MAP and an initial sequencing proposal by EOB Friday? Also cc procurement@bluebridgehealth.com on any contract routing.

Thanks,
Anika
Anika Rao
Head of Partnerships, BlueBridge Health
procurement@bluebridgehealth.com

Attachment: BlueBridge_RFP.pdf (summary file)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@bluebridgehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement MAP & contract sequencing for BlueBridge pilot

Hi Anika —

Appreciate the context and the RFP. I put together a draft mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out milestones, owners, and a proposed sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form + pilot acceptance checks. High-level sequencing suggestions in the doc:

- Week 0 (now): Security questionnaire + baseline evidence (SOC 2 report, encryption/KMS notes).
- Week 1–2: Commercial term discussions and order form draft (pricing, seat counts, pilot scope).
- Week 2–3: Legal review of standard MSA and DPA; we can do MSA signature concurrently with final DPA if minimal redlines.
- Pilot window: gated evaluation with specific acceptance tests (integration smoke tests, latency/cost baselines, sample data run).

A couple quick questions for procurement/legal so we can tighten the plan:
- Who will own signatory authority for the MSA and order form on your side (name/email)?
- Any mandatory legal clauses we should expect to see redlined (e.g., data residency, subprocessor list, indemnity caps)?
- Can you confirm whether BlueBridge requires HSM/KMS integration (we support KMS key wrapping; if you require customer-managed keys there are additional steps).

I’ve cc’d Laura and Karthik for intake on the DPA/MSA posture and sequencing. We’ll update the MAP and push a version with explicit dates once we have the procurement lead + legal constraints.

I’ll send MAP_v1.xlsx now and loop in our legal ops to prepare a redline-ready MSA (redlines_msa.docx).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: sequencing notes & legal/compliance checklist for BlueBridge

Stephanie / Laura —

Quick internal notes on the MAP draft after a 15-minute sync with Legal Ops:

1) Evidence pack (should be attached to MAP): SOC 2 Type II summary, data flow diagram, encryption-at-rest/in-transit statement, subprocessor list. Procurement will ask for these first — we should send as a single zipped packet.

2) DPA posture: BlueBridge likely wants limited-data residency language and specific retention windows. If retention windows are strict we may need to call out order form fields that set retention and export behavior.

3) MSA redlines: typical asks (cap on liability, service credits, indemnity carveouts). Legal prefers to keep MSA changes light; if they insist on broad changes they will push to a commercial exception review which adds ~2 weeks.

4) Order form dependencies: we must finalize pricing & billing contact before order form can be signed. Order form should reference the signed MSA + effective DPA. In tight timelines we can execute MSA with a DPA addendum pending final subprocessor appendix.

5) Pilot acceptance criteria (suggested):
   - Integration smoke test success (3 endpoints)
   - Latency P95 <= 400ms on sample traffic
   - Security checklist completed and SOC2 artifacts uploaded
   - Data deletion/retention verification for sample dataset

6) Owners/resources: Legal Ops will own MSA redline coordination (Rafael). Product/Eng will own pilot gating (Karthik). You (Stephanie) own MAP updates / external coordination.

Action items: attach redlines_msa.docx to the outbound MAP, and prepare a short evidence packet. I’ll draft a simple sequencing slide we can drop into the MAP for Friday.

-Karthik

Attachment: redlines_msa.docx (internal suggested redline template)
From: Anika Rao <anika@bluebridgehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@bluebridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement MAP & contract sequencing for BlueBridge pilot

Thanks, Stephanie and team — this looks good. A couple items from procurement/legal:

- Procurement can commit to an MSA signature window of July 26–30 if we receive the MSA + SOC2 summary and DPA terms by July 16. Legal has one critical ask: data retention windows must be explicit (specifically for PHI-derived logs) and we need clarity on deletion procedures.
- We prefer the DPA to be a simple addendum to the MSA (minimal redlines). If Redwood requires a separate DPA execution flow that could delay us.
- Pilot evaluation window: Jul 29–Aug 20 works for our clinical team — acceptance decision by Aug 24.

Routing: please send the finalized MSA + DPA to procurement@bluebridgehealth.com and add me as a cc. Procurement will route to the signatory (I’ll share contact vCard).

I’m attaching the procurement contact vCard for the signatory and our internal procurement tracker (procurement_contact.vcf). Looking forward to the DocuSign envelope when you’re ready.

Best,
Anika

Anika / procurement team —

Thanks for the timeline clarity. Per our internal checklist and your asks, next steps below and owners:

1) Evidence packet (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, subprocessor list) — Rafael (Legal Ops) will upload to your secure share by EOD 2026-07-15.
2) Updated MAP & sequencing slide (MAP_v1 -> MAP_v2) with explicit dates and pilot acceptance artifacts — Stephanie (owner) will send MAP_v2 by 2026-07-16.
3) Final MSA + DPA draft for signature (target envelope) — Rafael to prepare and route via DocuSign once procurement confirms signatory. Target: send DocuSign envelope 2026-07-20 to hit your July 26–30 window.
4) Order form: commercial terms to be finalized after pricing call — Laura to run pricing sync on 2026-07-14 and circulate draft order form for review.

Quick notes: we can execute the MSA with a DPA addendum to avoid full-separate flows; the MAP will call this out. If legal requests broad MSA changes that go to exception review, we’ll surface that immediately and propose mitigations (timeboxed signoff, escrow of disputed terms, etc.).

HubSpot opportunity: https://hubspot.redwood/opp/BB-2026-07-01 — I’ve updated the close plan to reflect the July acceptance window and added milestones.

I’ll send MAP_v2 and the DocuSign envelope link once Rafael confirms the MSA package. Thanks — we’ll keep tight communication to hit the pilot timeline.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
